# The tests run once unmutated before anything is varied.
#
# If that baseline fails, nothing is mutated. Every mutant would be
# recorded as caught, but caught by the failure that was already there
# rather than by the mutation, so the whole report would read as full
# coverage of a suite that is not even passing.

! muxt test-template-mutations
stderr '(?m)^Error: baseline tests failed before mutation; fix them first:$'
stderr '(?m)^--- FAIL: TestGreeting'
! stdout .

-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- templates.gohtml --
{{define "greeting"}}Hello, {{.Name}}!{{end}}
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateFiles embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateFiles, "*.gohtml"))

type Greeting struct {
	Name string
}
-- render_test.go --
package server

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestGreeting(t *testing.T) {
	var buf strings.Builder
	if err := templates.ExecuteTemplate(&buf, "greeting", Greeting{Name: "World"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got, want := buf.String(), "this assertion is wrong"; got != want {
		t.Errorf("greeting = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
}
